Title: Public preview: Azure Arc integration with VMware vSphere and Azure VMware Solution

Body.Content:
Azure Arc-enabled VMware vSphere, a new Azure Arc capability, is now available in public preview. It was first announced at Microsoft Ignite last year as part of the private preview of some new capabilities in Azure Arc. 

You can use Azure Arc-enabled VMware vSphere to connect your VMware vCenter servers to Azure and manage the lifecycle and guest OS operations of VMware VMs through Azure Arc. The same offering is also available for use with Azure VMware Solutions private clouds.

Learn more about Azure Arc-enabled VMware vSphere and how to connect your VMware vCenter to Azure. 

Learn how to deploy Arc for your Azure VMware Solutions private cloud
